caption:
UK Department for Work and Pensions takes services offline after cyber incident

The department says benefit and pension payments will be paid as normal while it works with cyber security experts. There is little information on which services are affected or how long the disruption will last.

Reported by The Guardian; Financial Times; CNA.

headlines: UK Department for Work and Pensions takes services offline after cyber incident
photo_alt: Lines of code on a computer monitor
dek: Officials say pension and benefit payments will continue to be made.
body: Almost all pensions and benefits systems went offline on Friday morning. People could not check a state pension, apply for disability benefits or claim universal credit. The department is working with cyber security experts and Britain's cyber security authorities to investigate and restore services.
